what_this_is: The MF-5 enabler cell for SLURP: the sealed closed-list direct baseline's own prompt, roster, packets, build, geometry and decoding, flown as the ONE-PHASE phase program phase-direct-only-v1 through rails.phase_runner.run_program instead of core.flight.FlightRuntime's fixed-policy direct dispatch. It exists to prove the multi-phase seal path end to end on the cheapest possible program -- one phase, one contact per sample, no knowledge, no predecessor -- so the two-contact SLURP cells (KC-S1a/b, KU-S1/S1c, KU-S3) fly on a harness that has already been shown to seal one row per sample.
the_one_difference_from_slurp_direct_clo: policy. slurp-direct-closed-list.json declares 'fixed' and goes through FlightRuntime._run_speech_feature_direct: one system message, one input_speech_features user part, no history. This fragment declares 'phase-direct-only-v1' and goes through rails.runner.run_speech_native_agent_loop, which adds exactly one thing to the payload -- the ORG/CONTROL history turn carrying probes/slurp_phase_direct.txt (rails.core_client._agent_history). The system message, the packet, the arm, the decoding parameters and the scorers are identical. Its numbers are therefore NOT interchangeable with the sealed closed-list baseline's and are never reported as that baseline; the added control turn is a real prompt difference.
knowledge_is_bound_but_invisible: rails.runner.run_speech_native_agent_loop requires a validated, non-empty KnowledgeSnapshot for every agent-loop contact even when no phase consumes it. The frozen TRAIN snapshot named above is bound with empty bootstrap_facet_ids/bootstrap_value_ids, so the initial QueryState makes no facet and no value visible and rails.runner._agent_messages renders none of it into the prompt. What the binding actually buys is the leakage rule: core.flight.FlightRuntime refuses, before any contact, a phase instruction that contains any facet or value text of 8 characters or more, which is the same rule rails.runner enforces at request time.
instruction_basis: Identical to slurp-direct-closed-list.json's: the sealed 2026-08-25 DEV-1000 M0 instruction (sha256 cef527896e9beef5774305e01dc29192fc2d5ca89fba5143e82f0b91a7cb86b8, 5,747 characters) plus the 1,836-character closed label inventory suffix, rendered from the same hash-pinned template and the same registered fill. The flight script asserts that prefix relation before takeoff.
arm_basis: speech-feature-query, the same arm and audio path the sealed DEV-1000 arms flew: mmproj-free decode over pre-materialized encoder packets from the registered DEV-1000 promotion receipt, one input_speech_features query descriptor per contact.
scorer_basis: Unchanged from slurp-direct-closed-list.json: slurp-slu-official is the paper-facing scorer (the real, unmodified official evaluate.py at pinned commit 8eb16545762be97ace75334109d73824217311f1, --average micro), slurp-slu names the carrier's own scorer id, and both are run once over the complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded.
